description: Return file paths of screencast JPEG frames around a target time window for multimodal vision analysis. Choose ONE mode: at+window (centered on video time from start), last (duration before newest frame), or since_last (frames since previous query). Returns at most max frames (default 16), downsampled with high-motion preference when Pillow is available.

at.description: Video timestamp to center on (MM:SS or seconds from screencast start).

last.description: Duration before newest frame on disk (e.g. '5s').

max.description: Maximum frame paths to return (downsampled if window has more).

since_last.description: Return only frames captured after previous watch_query call.

name: browser_watch_query
